title: HandPosition
description: Adjust the position and rotation of your first-person hands with smooth sliders
body:
This mod lets you customize the position and rotation of your hands in first-person view. Both hands can be adjusted independently.

Move each hand on X, Y, and Z axes.
Rotate each hand on all three axes.

the settings menu:
Independent left and right hand control.

Settings save automatically and persist between sessions.

Reset button to restore default values.

Open the game Options menu and click the **Hand Setting** button on the right. Adjust the sliders for each hand and click Save.
